sources.title: Agency for Identification Documents, Registers and Data Exchange of Bosnia and Herzegovina (iddeea.gov.ba), passports
sources.said: Applications for civil passports are submitted in person according to the applicant’s place of residence and are issued by: Cantonal Ministries of Interior in the Federation of BiH, Ministry of Interior of Republika Srpska, Public Register of Brčko District of BiH. ... Diplomatic and consular missions of Bosnia and Herzegovina issue passports to citizens residing abroad for three months or longer, in accordance with the Law on Travel Documents of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Validity Period A passport for citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina is issued with a validity period of ten years. For citizens under three years of age, the passport is issued with a validity period of three years, and for citizens aged three to eighteen years, with a validity period of five years. ... Issuance Deadlines Regular procedure: 30 days from the date of application Urgent procedure: within 72 hours (in accordance with the law and prescribed conditions)
